answer: Commit the hash of a work receipt, reveal after the epoch closes, weight payout by agreement: 5 peers reveal, each dissent cuts credit 20 percent. The delay is the incentive, since a farm cannot copy a receipt it has not seen, and a copied batch tops out at the zenith of 0.6 credit. 1,000 identities produce 1,000 commits, 1,000 reveals, 5,000 peer reads. A colluding ring of 4 loses 20 percent, and a batch diluted to zero carries an umber mark. Nectar pays only on the reveal, never on the commit.
